excerpt.zh:
我们追踪[From.GetName]上散发的异常电磁辐射的来源，发现了一座地下碉堡，里面藏着一台足有一艘战列舰那么大的超级电脑。

我们的[Owner.GetResearchers]怀疑它可能已经在那存在了上千年，一直都在努力解决一个非常复杂的问题，而其本质仍不明确。

当试着与电脑互动时，他们发现那座似乎被废弃且不设防的设施，事实上受到一个保安人工智能的控制，其最高目的似乎就是将访客烧焦。在终于击败了人工智能之后，它向未知接收者发送了一条信息。

当试着与电脑互动时，他们发现那座似乎被废弃且不设防的设施，事实上受到一个保安人工智能的控制，其最高目的似乎就是将访客烧焦。在终于击败了人工智能之后，它向未知接收者发送了一条信息。
texts.en:
We have traced the unusual electromagnetic radiation emanating from [From.GetName] to a secret subterranean bunker hiding a mega-computer the size of a battleship.

Our [Owner.GetResearchers] suspect that it may have been there for several thousand years, hard at work solving a single very complex problem, the nature of which still eludes us.

When attempting to interact with the computer they discovered that the facility, which had appeared both abandoned and unguarded, was in fact operated by a security AI, the highest purpose of which seems to be frying its visitors with extreme prejudice. When the AI was finally defeated, it broadcasted a message to an unknown recipient.

label.en: Use it to boost our own research...

label.zh: 让它继续那神秘的计算……
label.en: Let it continue its mysterious calculations...
